tools.name: review_submit
tools.description: Request an independent review using a fresh model conversation with no tools or builder history. The service renders current evidence itself. First inspect contact_sheet with no media and render_frames with phone:true after the last edit. Fix claims must reference last review IDs and have newly rendered frames near each moment. Missing evidence never counts as passed; unavailable temporal scan/export rehearsal is reported as incomplete. Never provide your own scores.

fixes.description: What you fixed since the last round, by the review's ids.

defect.description: A blocker or defect id from the last review (d1, d2, …).

scores.description: Ignored: Biliup's critic scores the video, not you.

defects.description: Ignored: the critic lists the defects.

notes.description: Ignored by the critic (it never sees your reasoning).

tools.returns: the critic's round: scores with evidence, blockers and defects with ids, each claimed fix verified or not, the determinism check and what to do next
